strings.%@ je na stejném kontinentu – v RTTY QTC: %@ is on the same continent – QTC not allowed in RTTY
strings.%@ není v Nastavení → Online zapnuto: %@ is not enabled in Settings → Online
%@. Check the date in the contest rules.
strings.%N odesílané číslo nebo výměna · %M přij: %N sent number or exchange · %M received · %x / %y number and time (BARTG) · %r / %s RST
strings.%m moje značka · %c protistanice · %n jm: %m my call · %c other station · %n name · %q QTH · %k rig frequency in kHz · %D %T %t UTC time · one line = one command · \ # and CW ID are ignored

%m my call · %c other station · %n name · %q QTH · %r RST sent · %s received · %N sent number · %M received number · %g greeting · %D %T %t UTC time · %L %F LTRS/FIGS · %{…} CW ID · %l log QSO · \ at end = RX · # at end = stay in TX
strings.1 bod za spojení a 1 za každé odeslané i: 1 point per QSO and 1 per QTC sent or received. Score = (QSO + QTC) × band-weighted multipliers.
strings.1 bod za spojení. Skóre = body × násobič: 1 point per QSO. Score = points × multipliers (countries and areas per band) × continents.
strings.1 bod za spojení; stejnou stanici jen je: 1 point per QSO; each station once per band. Score = points × multipliers.
strings.1. celý víkend v lednu · RST + číslo (W/: 1st full weekend of January · RST + number (W/VE state)
strings.2. celý víkend v listopadu · RST + číslo: 2nd full weekend of November · RST + number, QTC
strings.2. celý víkend v únoru · RST + číslo: 2nd full weekend of February · RST + number
strings.2. celý víkend v říjnu · RST + lokátor (: 2nd full weekend of October · RST + locator (4 chars), three periods
strings.2. dekodér: stejný signál jiným demodulá: 2nd decoder: the same signal with another demodulator, text in the panel below RX
strings.20, 15 a 10 m: vlastní kontinent 1 bod,: 20, 15 and 10 m: own continent 1 point, other continent 2; 80 and 40 m: 3 and 6. Score = points × multipliers.
strings.3. celý víkend v březnu · RST + číslo +: 3rd full weekend of March · RST + number + time
strings.3. celý víkend v prosinci · RST + CQ zón: 3rd full weekend of December · RST + CQ zone
strings.3. celý víkend v srpnu · RST + číslo, tř: 3rd full weekend of August · RST + number, three periods
strings.3. celý víkend v říjnu · RST + věk operá: 3rd full weekend of October · RST + operator's age (YL 00)
strings.AFC jen při otevřeném squelchi: AFC only when squelch is open
strings.AFC · kontextová nabídka: vazba na squel: AFC · context menu: squelch gating, range limit
strings.AFSK = RTTY zvukem (rádio v SSB/DATA). F: AFSK = RTTY via audio (radio in SSB/DATA). FSK = keying via serial line (radio in FSK/RTTY mode).
strings.API klíč si vyžádáte u Club Log (Setting: Request the API key from Club Log (Settings → Api Keys). Passwords and the key are stored in the Keychain, not in the settings.
strings.API naslouchá jen na tomto Macu (127.0.0: The API listens on this Mac only (127.0.0.1).
The update address is not set.
strings.Azimut krátkou cestou podle země spotu: Short-path azimuth by the spot's country
strings.Bez rigu zadejte pásmo nebo frekvenci ru: Without a rig enter the band or frequency manually – it is written to the log
strings.Body = vzdálenost středů čtverců lokátor: Points = distance between locator square centres in km (rounded down) × band weight (80 m × 2, 40 m × 1.5, others × 1, rounded down again); same square 100 points without weight. Score = sum of points.
strings.Během vysílání se rig nepřelaďuje: The rig is not retuned while transmitting
strings.Během vysílání se rig nepřelaďuje – frek: The rig is not retuned while transmitting – enter the frequency after returning to RX.
strings.Během vysílání se rig nepřelaďuje – spot: The rig is not retuned while transmitting – use the spot after returning to RX.
strings.CQ zóny, země DXCC + seznam WAE a W/VE Q: CQ zones, DXCC countries + WAE list and W/VE QTH (48 states + DC, 14 Canadian areas) on each band. KH6 and KL7 are countries only.
strings.CR/LF na začátku vysílání tlačítkem TX: Send CR/LF when starting TX with the TX button
Language code or name is missing.
strings.Co pošle Enter v poli Call nebo výměny: What Enter sends in the Call or exchange field
strings.Core Audio měří skutečnou vzorkovací fre: Core Audio measures the device's actual sample rate against the system clock (NTP). Range ± 20,000 ppm.
strings.DX cluster není připojený – příkaz nebyl: DX cluster is not connected – command not sent.
strings.Demodulátor druhého dekodéru (auto = jin: Second decoder demodulator (auto = different from the main one)
strings.Druhý dekodér přijímá na stejném naladěn: The second decoder receives on the same tuning as the main one but with another demodulator (without its own AFC). Receive only.
strings.Duplicita: se stanicí už je v tomto závo: Dupe: you already worked this station in this contest on the same band and mode
strings.Duplicitní klíče v souboru: %ld (platí p: Duplicate keys in the file: %ld (the first one applies).
strings.Duplicity (stejná stanice, pásmo a mód): Dupes (same station, band and mode) score 0 points. The result is an estimate – log checking removes busted and unconfirmed QSOs.
strings.Dvojklik: nastaví rig na frekvenci spotu: Double-click: sets the rig to the spot frequency + offset and puts the call into the QSO window. A radio in LSB/AFSK mode with mark 2125 Hz needs an offset of +2125 Hz. “✓ band” = the call is already in the log on this band.
strings.ESM používá makra podle pořadí (F1, F4,: ESM uses macros by position (F1, F4, F5…). After importing macros, check the assignment in Settings → Contest → ESM.
strings.Engine neběží (zvuk nespuštěn?) – rig ne: Engine is not running (audio not started?) – cannot tune the rig.
strings.Engine neběží – rig nelze přeladit: Engine is not running – cannot tune the rig
strings.FSK/PTT na portu %@ nelze převést (porty: FSK/PTT on port %@ cannot be converted (COM ports do not exist on macOS); choose the port in Settings → FSK.
strings.Filtry příjmu (pravé tlačítko ve spektru: RX filters (right-click in spectrum = notch) and UOS
strings.Frekvence se nečte a PTT přes CAT není k: Frequency is not read and PTT via CAT is not available.
strings.Heslo callbooku nelze uložit do Klíčenky: Cannot save the callbook password to the Keychain: %@
strings.Heslo nelze uložit do Klíčenky: %@: Cannot save the password to the Keychain: %@
strings.Hledají se dvojice tónů vzdálené o shift: Looks for tone pairs one shift apart above the noise.
strings.Hlídané značky: jedna na řádek (porovnáv: Watched calls: one per line (the base call without /P is compared). Countries come from cty.dat and are compared with the log. Checked in spots (marked in the Needed column) and in the RX text; each call only once. Notification permission is requested only when enabled.
strings.Hlídat novou zemi na aktuálním pásmu: Watch for a new country on the current band
strings.Hlídat novou zemi vůbec: Watch for a new country at all
strings.Ignorováno %ld nastavení bez protějšku v: Ignored %ld settings without a counterpart in mmtty4mac (windows, fonts, colors, TNC, log…).
strings.Jazyk se přepne hned ve všech oknech. Ja: The language switches immediately in all windows. Language files (cs.json, en.json…) are in the languages folder and can be edited – a saved change applies immediately. New translation: save the template, translate the values in “strings”, set “code” and “name” and load the file.
strings.Jen závodní spojení (s číslem nebo výměn: Contest QSOs only (with number or exchange)
strings.Jiný kontinent 3 body (80 a 40 m: 6), st: Other continent 3 points (80 and 40 m: 6), same continent different country 2 (4), same country 1 (2). Score = points × prefixes.
strings.Jiný kontinent 3 body, stejný kontinent: Other continent 3 points, same continent different country 2, same country 1. Score = points × (zones + countries + W/VE QTH).
strings.Jádro demodulátoru a modulátoru: MMTTY ©: Demodulator and modulator core: MMTTY © 2000–2013 Makoto Mori (JE3HHT), Nobuyuki Oba.
strings.Kategorie jako „KLÍČ: hodnota“ oddělené: Category as “KEY: value” separated by semicolons. QTC (WAE) counts only QSOs since the contest start. Export: Log → Export Cabrillo…
strings.Každý den UTC jeden soubor rx-RRRR-MM-DD: One file per UTC day, rx-YYYY-MM-DD.txt. The switch is also in the File menu. Save the RX window contents with File → Save RX text to file…
strings.Každý kanál je samostatný dekodér (s AFC: Each channel is a separate decoder (with AFC) on an RTTY signal found in the spectrum. List in the Channels window.
strings.Každý prefix jednou za závod (PA/N8BJQ =: Each prefix once per contest (PA/N8BJQ = PA0, XEFTJW = XE0, /P /M /MM /QRP are ignored).
strings.Každý řádek musí mít tvar „HHMM ZNAČKA N: Each line must look like “HHMM CALL NNN”, 1–10 lines.
strings.Klik = naladit mark · pravé tlačítko = z: Click = tune mark · right-click = notch · scroll wheel = squelch level
strings.Klik na slova v příjmu: série n/k, pak č: Click words in the RX text: series n/k, then time, call, number.
strings.Klik na slovo = vložit do QSO: Click a word = put into QSO
strings.Klikni na zkratku a stiskni novou kombin: Click a shortcut and press a new key combination. Delete = no shortcut, Esc = cancel. A plain letter without a modifier is not allowed (it would clash with typing).
strings.Kontrola proběhne při startu nejvýš jedn: The check runs at startup at most once a day. A new version is never installed automatically – the DMG is downloaded and you drag the app into Applications. Manual check: app menu → Check for Updates…
strings.LoTW: spojení už byla nahrána nebo jsou: LoTW: the QSOs were already uploaded or are outside the date range.
strings.LoTW: část spojení už byla nahrána, zbyt: LoTW: some QSOs were already uploaded, the rest was sent.
strings.Log převeden z ADIF: %ld spojení, přesko: Log converted from ADIF: %ld QSOs, %ld skipped. Original file: %@
strings.Log „%@“ už existuje – otevřete ho přes: Log “%@” already exists – open it with Open Log.
strings.Makra a zprávy obsahovala řídicí znaky M: Macros and messages contained MMTTY control characters _ ~ [ ] (%ld) that mmtty4mac does not send; removed.
strings.Makro %@ je prázdné – nastavte ho v Nast: Macro %@ is empty – set it in Settings → Contest → ESM
strings.Makrothen nemá násobiče – body podle vzd: Makrothen has no multipliers – points by the distance between locators and band weights.
strings.Nahraje dosud nenahraná spojení (služby: Uploads QSOs not uploaded yet (services are enabled in Settings → Online)
strings.Nahráno, ale stav se nepodařilo zapsat d: Uploaded, but the status could not be written to the log: %@
strings.Nahrává se příjem do WAV – kliknutím zas: Recording RX to WAV – click to stop
strings.Neplatná frekvence – zadejte kHz v rozsa: Invalid frequency – enter kHz between 100 and 500,000.
strings.Neplatná frekvence „%@“ – zadejte kHz v: Invalid frequency “%@” – enter kHz between 100 and 500,000.
strings.Násobiče se počítají jen v zapnutém závo: Multipliers are counted only in an enabled contest with a selected preset (Settings → Contest).
strings.Návrhy značek pod polem Call: Call suggestions below the Call field
strings.Obraz disku je otevřený. Přetáhněte mmtt: The disk image is open. Drag mmtty4mac into the Applications folder (it replaces the old version).
strings.Odhad skóre závodu podle pravidel předvo: Estimated contest score by the preset's rules (Window → Score)
strings.Opakování maker mimo rozsah 0,1–3600 s n: Macro repeat intervals outside 0.1–3600 s were not imported: %@.
strings.Otevřít příjem QTC bez vysílání (série u: Open QTC receive without transmitting (series already came or is coming)
strings.PTT na portu %@ nelze převést (porty COM: PTT on port %@ cannot be converted (COM ports do not exist on macOS); choose the port in Settings → PTT.
strings.Parametr %@ má hodnotu mimo povolený roz: Parameter %@ has a value outside the allowed range; skipped.
strings.Po zadání značky doplní jméno, lokátor a: After entering a call, fills in the other station's name, locator and exchange from the file (N1MM Call History: header !!Order!!, or simple CSV Call,Name,Exch1). The history takes precedence over the DXCC zone and the callbook; values entered by hand are not overwritten. The call count updates after saving the settings.
strings.Po zadání značky v okně QSO se dohledá j: After entering a call in the QSO window the name, QTH and locator are looked up. The password is stored in the Keychain. Requests go to the service only when the callbook is enabled.
You are using the latest version.
strings.Pozor: API nemá autentizaci a umí zapnou: Warning: the API has no authentication and can key the transmitter – enable only on a trusted network.
strings.Počty spojení podle pásem (v závodě od z: QSOs per band (in a contest since the contest start)
strings.Pravidla píší „body na každém pásmu × ná: The rules say “points on each band × multipliers on each band” – computed as total points × total multipliers (the usual reading).
strings.Pravidlo neověřeno v oficiálních pravidl: Rule not verified in the official rules.
strings.Pro ostatní rádia: aplikace sama spustí: For other radios: the app starts rigctld itself with the selected model and port (hamlib from Homebrew).
strings.Protistanice nabízí QTC: otevřít příjem: The other station offers QTC: open receive and send QRV
strings.Protistanice potvrdila příjem (R R ALL O: The other station confirmed receipt (R R ALL OK)
strings.Prázdná makra (%@) – Enter je nespustí;: Empty macros (%@) – Enter will not send them; fill them in or choose others.
strings.Prázdné = moje CQ zóna podle značky (DXC: Empty = my CQ zone from my call (DXCC).
strings.Prázdné = moje CQ zóna podle značky; W/V: Empty = my CQ zone from my call; W/VE add their state, e.g. “05 NY”.
strings.Prázdné = posílá se pořadové číslo; jina: Empty = serial number is sent; otherwise this text (e.g. state).
strings.Průběžně zapisovat příjem do souboru: Log RX text to file continuously
strings.Předvolba nastaví název, formát výměny a: The preset sets the name, exchange format and next start of a well-known contest.
strings.Přeladit hlavní dekodér na tento signál: Tune the main decoder to this signal
strings.Přeladit rig na RTTY kmitočet pásma: Tune the rig to the band's RTTY frequency
strings.Při psaní značky nabízí známé značky z M: While typing a call it suggests known calls from MASTER.SCP (supercheckpartial.com) and from your log; “≈” = calls differing by one character (to correct a miscopied call). In a contest a red DUPE warns about a repeated QSO on the same band and mode.
strings.Přihlášení značkou ze záložky Stanice. P: Login with the call from the Station tab. Example servers: dxc.ve7cc.net:23, dxfun.com:8000. Commands, one per line: set/skimmer, sh/dx 30.
strings.Příkaz je příliš dlouhý (nejvýš %ld znak: Command is too long (at most %ld characters).
strings.Příkazy lze odeslat, až je DX cluster př: Commands can be sent once the DX cluster is connected.
strings.Přístup k mikrofonu zamítnut – povolte h: Microphone access denied – allow it in System Settings → Privacy → Microphone. Receive does not work.
strings.RTTY pro macOS – nativní přepis MMTTY s: RTTY for macOS – a native port of MMTTY with an API for loggers (fldigi XML-RPC, JSON-RPC).
strings.RTTY: evropské i mimoevropské násobiče p: RTTY: European and non-European multipliers count for all stations. WAE countries on each band, call areas for W/VE/VK/ZL/ZS/JA/BY/PY and RA8/RA9/RA0. Band weights: 80 m × 4, 40 m × 3, others × 2.
RX %@ ppm, TX %@ ppm – confirm with Apply.
strings.Reverse Beacon Network: telnet.reversebe: Reverse Beacon Network: telnet.reversebeacon.net:7000 (CW and RTTY skimmers). The spot stream is large, keeping “RTTY only” is recommended.
strings.Rig frekvenci nepřijal: The rig did not accept the frequency
strings.Rig se nastaví na frekvenci spotu (u RTT: The rig is set to the spot frequency (for RTTY it is the mark) + offset. A radio in LSB/AFSK mode with mark 2125 Hz needs an offset of +2125 Hz. The network is used only for enabled services; changes after Apply.
strings.Rozsah a zesílení jdou měnit i v menu v: Range and gain can also be changed in the menu in the top-left corner of the spectrum.
strings.Rozsah a zesílení spektra a vodopádu: Spectrum and waterfall range and gain
strings.Rychlost a stop bity musí odpovídat nast: Speed and stop bits must match the CAT settings in the radio menu. For PTT via CAT choose the CAT method on the PTT / FSK tab – the CAT port cannot be shared with RTS/DTR PTT.
strings.Rychlost závodu: počet spojení za posled: Contest rate: QSOs in the last 10 and 60 minutes converted to per hour
strings.S %@: vyměněno %ld/10 · k odeslání %ld ·: With %@: exchanged %ld/10 · to send %ld · next series %ld
strings.Seznam uložených zpráv – výběr zprávu od: List of saved messages – selecting one sends it (macro syntax)
strings.Skóre se počítá jen v zapnutém závodě se: Score is computed only when contest mode is on with a preset selected (Settings → Contest).
The file is longer than 2 hours.
strings.Soubor je příliš dlouhý (max. 20 000 zna: The file is too long (max. 20,000 characters).
strings.Soubor je větší než 1 MB – nejde o Mmtty: The file is larger than 1 MB – not an Mmtty.ini; nothing is imported.
strings.Soubor není platný jazykový JSON: %@: The file is not a valid language JSON: %@
strings.Soubor nevypadá jako Mmtty.ini z MMTTY –: The file does not look like an MMTTY Mmtty.ini – no known settings found.
strings.Spektrum · klik = naladit mark · pravé t: Spectrum · click = tune mark · right-click = notch · scroll wheel = squelch
strings.Spojení (JSONL + ADIF) a série QTC se uk: QSOs (JSONL + ADIF) and QTC series are stored in this folder. Create or open another log in the File menu (New Log…, Open Log…).
strings.Spojení se podepíšou a odešlou programem: QSOs are signed and sent by TQSL (certificate and Station Location must be set up in TQSL).
strings.Spojení se značkou bez známé země/kontin: A QSO with a call of unknown country/continent gets the lowest point value.
strings.Spoty jsou vypnuté – zapněte DX cluster: Spots are off – enable DX cluster or RBN in Settings → Spots.
strings.Spoty: v nastavení Stanice chybí značka: Spots: the call for login is missing in Station settings.
strings.Stanice OK/OL: země DXCC na každém pásmu: OK/OL stations: DXCC countries on each band.
strings.Stejný kontinent (i vlastní země) 2 body: Same continent (incl. own country) 2 points, other continent 3. Score = points × multipliers.
strings.Stejný kontinent – v RTTY se QTC vyměňuj: Same continent – in RTTY, QTC are exchanged only between continents.
strings.Syntaxe jako makra: %c %m %n %r %g … · \: Same syntax as macros: %c %m %n %r %g … · \ at end = RX · # at end = stay in TX · %l = log QSO
strings.Systémové oznámení u potřebných značek a: System notification for needed calls and countries
strings.Systémové oznámení, když mě někdo volá (: System notification when someone calls me (only when the app is not active)
strings.Série: %ld · odesláno %ld QTC · přijato: Series: %ld · sent %ld QTC · received %ld QTC · QTC points %ld · QSO %ld
strings.TQSL nenalezen. Nainstalujte TrustedQSL: TQSL not found. Install TrustedQSL (tqsl.app) or enter the path to tqsl in Settings → Online.
strings.Tato tři nastavení se projeví po Použít: These three settings take effect after Apply (the modem is recreated).
strings.Tento zdroj se u zvoleného demodulátoru: This source is not filled for the selected demodulator.
strings.V Info.plist aplikace je klíč MMUpdateFe: The MMUpdateFeedURL key in the app's Info.plist is empty, update checking is off.
Your call %@ is in the RX text.
strings.V souboru není nic, co by šlo importovat: There is nothing to import in the file.
strings.V závodě Enter v poli Call nebo výměny p: In a contest Enter in the Call or exchange field sends a macro depending on the state: Run – CQ, exchange, TU and log; S&P – my call, exchange and log. If the TU or S&P exchange macro has no %l, the QSO is logged automatically. Enter sends nothing while transmitting. Run / S&P is also switched in the QSO panel and with %@.
strings.Vaše značka červeně tučně, duplicita v z: Your call red bold, contest dupe gray strikethrough, call already in the log blue, new call bold. The echo of your own transmission is not highlighted.
Your call is missing in Station settings.
strings.Vestavěné ovládání bez dalších programů:: Built-in control without other programs: frequency, mode and PTT directly over the radio's USB cable.
strings.Vlastní země 5 bodů, jiná země na vlastn: Own country 5 points, other country on own continent 10, other continent 15. Score = points × multipliers.
strings.Vyberte službu a zadejte uživatele a hes: Choose a service and enter user and password.
strings.Vyberte soubor Mmtty.ini z Windows MMTTY: Choose the Mmtty.ini file from Windows MMTTY.
strings.Vyberte soubor historie značek (N1MM Cal: Choose the call history file (N1MM Call History, .txt or .csv)
strings.Vyberte zprávu vlevo: Select a message on the left
strings.Vyberte, co se má přepsat. Původní hodno: Choose what to overwrite. The original values will be replaced.
strings.Zapněte DX cluster nebo RBN (Nastavení →: Enable DX cluster or RBN (Settings → Spots).
strings.Zapněte ho přepínačem nahoře – dekodéry: Turn it on with the switch at the top – the decoders tune themselves to RTTY signals in the waterfall.
Device is not running – start receiving.
strings.Zda se země OK počítá i jako země DXCC v: Whether the OK country also counts as a DXCC country next to OK/OL stations – the rules do not say explicitly, both are counted.
The ATC source requires ATC to be on.
strings.Země DXCC (včetně JA, W, VE, VK) a oblas: DXCC countries (including JA, W, VE, VK) and JA/W/VE/VK areas on each band; continents once per contest (max. 6), multiplied separately in the score.
strings.Země DXCC (včetně VK, VE, JA, W) a oblas: DXCC countries (including VK, VE, JA, W) and VK/VE/JA/W areas on each band.
strings.Země DXCC a každá stanice OK/OL na každé: DXCC countries and each OK/OL station on each band.
strings.Země DXCC kromě JA/W/VE/VK a místo nich: DXCC countries except JA/W/VE/VK and instead their call areas, on each band (portable without a digit = area 0).
strings.Země DXCC kromě USA a Kanady (KH6 a KL7: DXCC countries except USA and Canada (KH6 and KL7 are countries), US states + DC, Canadian provinces and territories + LB – each once per contest. Enter the state/province in the exchange field.
strings.Zeptat se, zda má protistanice QTC: Ask whether the other station has QTC
strings.Zkouška otevře port zvlášť – když ho prá: The test opens the port separately – if the running app is using it, the test fails with a busy port.
Shortcuts without a counterpart on macOS: %@.
strings.Zkratky kolidující s jiným příkazem neby: Shortcuts clashing with another command were not imported: %@.
strings.Zkratky kolidující s menu macOS nebyly p: Shortcuts clashing with the macOS menu were not taken over: %@.
strings.Změny se projeví po Použít (restart zvuk: Changes take effect after Apply (restarts audio, rig and API). Modem parameters apply immediately.
strings.Značka s /číslice (W1ABC/3 → W3) – v pra: Call with /digit (W1ABC/3 → W3) – not stated in the CQ WPX rules, common practice used.
strings.Značka se posílá v makrech (%m) a podle: The call is sent in macros (%m) and determines the zone and continent (DXCC).
strings.Značka „%@“ není platná (jen A–Z, 0–9 a: Callsign “%@” is not valid (only A–Z, 0–9 and /, at most 15 characters); not imported.
strings.Zvolte pásmo (rig ani ruční frekvence ne: Choose a band (neither the rig nor the manual frequency is on a band with an RTTY segment).
strings.Zvuk nefunguje: %@ – zkontrolujte zaříze: Audio does not work: %@ – check the device and microphone permission
strings.Zvuk u potřebných značek a zemí: Sound for needed calls and countries
strings.Zvuk, když se v příjmu objeví moje značk: Sound when my call appears in the RX text
